business_problem: Bitron needed to unify fault tickets, technical manuals, telemetry, and production data spread across multiple platforms so operators could diagnose EV charging-station malfunctions faster, reduce downtime, and manage claims more effectively.
solution_summary: Bitron built an AI-assisted support and analytics stack on Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse with Oracle AI Vector Search, OCI Generative AI, and Oracle Analytics Cloud on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. The platform centralizes structured and unstructured information from charging-station telemetry, historical service records, production-process data, and technical documentation into one searchable repository. Oracle AI Vector Search and retrieval-augmented generation let operators query the knowledge base conversationally by error code, while OCI Generative AI uses Cohere and Llama models to generate recommendations during production and field-service workflows. Oracle Analytics Cloud provides a dashboard layer over the same unified dataset so line operators and executives can access production process data quickly. This design gives Bitron one AI-enabled data platform for troubleshooting and manufacturing analytics instead of separate silos for support content and operational reporting.

solution_components.name: Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse
solution_components.role: Stores Bitron's centralized operational, historical, and documentation data for diagnostics and analytics.

solution_components.name: Oracle AI Vector Search
solution_components.role: Performs semantic retrieval across structured and unstructured support and engineering content.

solution_components.name: OCI Generative AI
solution_components.role: Applies large language models and RAG to analyze error codes and generate recommendations for operators.

solution_components.name: Oracle Analytics Cloud
solution_components.role: Surfaces real-time production dashboards over the unified Bitron data set.

solution_components.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
solution_components.role: Hosts the underlying Oracle AI and database services used by the charging-station solution.

data_flow: Telemetry, error codes, fault tickets, technical manuals, and production data are centralized in Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse; Oracle AI Vector Search and OCI Generative AI retrieve relevant context and generate recommendations for operators; Oracle Analytics Cloud exposes the same data for real-time dashboarding and KPI analysis.
business_outcome: Bitron answered most operator questions automatically, diagnosed charging-station issues 5X faster, reduced downtime and operating cost, and gave both field teams and executives quicker access to unified production and service data.
